name: Black Hills Solar, Inc.
old_description: Generate your own electricity from sunlight. Reduce dependence on the grid and save money.
about:
Black Hills Solar, Inc. operates from Rapid City, South Dakota, providing solar energy and battery power system installations. The company focuses on residential and commercial applications, offering custom-designed systems that generate electricity from sunlight.

The firm installs custom solar power systems, backup battery and off-grid power solutions, electric vehicle charging stations, and smart electrical systems for energy management. It works with equipment from brands such as Tesla, Sol-Ark, SolarEdge, Enphase, and American-made Tier 1 solar panels.

Black Hills Solar serves homeowners and businesses in the Rapid City area seeking to generate their own electricity and reduce grid dependence. Its projects span residential rooftops and commercial facilities.

The company emphasizes professionally installed, custom-designed systems and proven technology from leading brands to deliver reliable energy independence.
